speaker: Quartermaster
text: Supplies are tight, friend. Keep bringing back whatever you find.

speaker: Quartermaster
text: The workshop's yours. Build it up, and we all eat.

speaker: Doc
text: Patching up raiders and fools. Guess which one you are.

speaker: Doc
text: Come back if you're bleeding. Not before.

speaker: Quartermaster
text: Dummies down? Fine work. Here is your pay.

speaker: Quartermaster
text: That is the timber. The workshop thanks you.

speaker: Quartermaster
text: The training ground is crawling with dummies. Scrap 5 of them for me.

speaker: Quartermaster
text: We need wood for the workshop. Bring back 3 pieces.

speaker: Doc
text: Back from the stage in one piece. Color me impressed.

speaker: Doc
text: Prove yourself: get into Stage 101 and extract alive.
